title: Select character and verify basic attack reduces opponent health
description: Player can select a character and successfully start a match, and basic attacks reduce opponent health.
preconditions: Game installed and no previous session active.
steps_actions:
1. "Launch the fighting game."
2. "Navigate to the character selection screen."
3. "Select the character named Ryu and confirm selection."
4. "Start a match against the CPU opponent."
5. "Press the basic punch button."
6. "Observe the opponents health bar."
steps_result:
1. "Game launches to main menu."
2. "Character selection screen is displayed."
3. "Selected character Ryu is highlighted."
4. "Match starts against CPU opponent."
5. "CPU opponent receives damage and health bar decreases."
6. "Health reduction matches expected damage value."

title: Attempt to select a locked character
description: Attempt to select a locked character should display a lock notification and prevent selection.
preconditions: Game launched, player has not unlocked 'Akuma'.
steps_actions:
1. "Launch the fighting game."
2. "Navigate to the character selection screen."
3. "Locate the locked character Akuma."
4. "Attempt to select Akuma."
steps_result:
1. "Character selection screen is displayed."
2. "Locked character Akuma shows a lock icon."
3. "Attempting to select Akuma displays a Character locked message."
4. "Selection does not change to Akuma."

title: Validate damage calculation logic
description: Unit test for damage calculation function ensures correct damage output for given inputs.
steps_result:
1. "Damage calculation returns 15 for a light punch against a standing opponent."
2. "Damage calculation returns 30 for a heavy kick against a crouching opponent."

title: Stress test rapid combo input for stability
description: Rapid input of combo commands should not cause the game to crash or become unresponsive.
steps_actions:
1. "Start a match against CPU."
2. "Rapidly press the combo button sequence (up, down, left, right, A, B, C) 50 times."
3. "Observe game behavior during and after the sequence."
steps_result:
1. "Game registers each input without freezing."
2. "No crash dialog appears."
3. "Game continues to run after the input sequence."

title: Verify leaderboard API returns correct data
description: API endpoint for retrieving the leaderboard returns a successful response with correct data format.
preconditions: Game server is running and reachable.
steps_actions:
1. "Send a GET request to /api/leaderboard."
2. "Validate the HTTP response code."
3. "Parse the response body and verify required fields."
steps_result:
1. "HTTP status code 200 is returned."
2. "Response body contains a JSON array of player entries with fields: playerId, rank, score."
3. "Expected result is verified."
